ai.title: Just ask Brocoli
ai.text: Brocoli is Moddy's AI assistant. Describe the setup you have in mind and it configures your server for you: modules, channels, roles, messages. Sensitive changes wait for your confirmation.
ai.label: Example conversation with Brocoli, Moddy's AI assistant
ai.prompt: Greet new members in #welcome and give them the Member role
ai.answer: Done! New members are now greeted in #welcome and get the Member role.

automod.title: AI moderation
automod.text: AutoMod AI checks messages as they are sent and applies your server's sanction: a warning, a mute or a ban. Each action is recorded as a case.
automod.author: troublemaker · today at 21:04
automod.message: Free nitro for everyone, click this link now!!
automod.detail: Scam link detected by AutoMod AI, case A7F2K9 opened

demo.m1: anyone up for a game tonight?

cases.title: Every sanction becomes a case
cases.text: Each warn, mute or ban becomes a case with its own reference code, a full timeline and built-in appeals.

social.title: YouTube, Twitch, Bluesky and RSS alerts
social.text: Post an update the moment a YouTube channel uploads, a Twitch streamer goes live, a Bluesky account posts or an RSS feed publishes.

modules.title: Turn on only the modules you need
modules.text: Welcome messages, tickets, logs, AltGuard and more. Each module is enabled and set up on its own, from /config or the dashboard.
modules.label: Some of Moddy's modules

logs.title: Server logs
logs.text: Server logs post a clear entry seconds after anything happens: an edited message, a new role, a ban, a permission change.

tickets.title: Support tickets
tickets.text: Members open a private ticket with a button or a dropdown. You decide where each request goes, which roles can see it and who claims it.

demo.welcome: Hi Alex, thanks for reaching out! A moderator will be with you shortly.
demo.user: Someone keeps sending me scam links in DMs.
demo.staff: Thanks for reporting it! Could you send a screenshot? I'll take care of it.

utilities.title: Commands that work in DMs too
utilities.text: Translate, set reminders, fix or summarize text, roll dice. Most commands work anywhere, even in your DMs.
utilities.label: Some of Moddy's commands

altguard.title: Stop ban evasion with AltGuard
altguard.text: New members verify before they get access. Accounts that match a banned member are flagged for review or blocked.

demo.blocked: Blocked · Same device as a banned account

dashboard.title: Configure from your browser
dashboard.text: Enable modules, review cases and customize the bot from the web dashboard, no command to remember.
